_read_me: Every number the core uses lives here. null = that rule is OFF until Love types a number. Love's words go in each _why.
_assets_why: Love Oct 30: 'its supposed to be pepperstone for btc and tvc gold for gold.'
_session_why: Session VWAP resets at 5 PM New York every day (DST handled by the clock, never a fixed UTC hour). Confirm.
_rollingVwap_why: Love Nov 5: 'she uses a rolling vwap doesnt she? ... along with the sessions'. Desk today: last 12 x 5m bars = 60 min. Grok OG (R098): rolling 60-min.
_minAskCents_why: Cheapest ask she may buy (smoke test Nov 5: with this off she called 1-2c lottery tickets). Love to fill.
_breakPush_why: Love: breaks are judged on 5m lines, a 10c push on gold, $5 on BTC.
_intoBandWall_why: Love: keep the into-band $25 wall. Gold number to confirm.
_thirds_why: R141 Love Oct 28: '33% NEVER. EVER. LEAVES.' R005/R236 gold sliding 33% under $10, 20% $10-25, 15% over $25 ('gold has a sliding scale love i already answered it'). R237 BTC 20% over $500 ('ITS 20% AT THIS BAND WIDTH'). R335 'make it a 3% margin of error both sides pls'. R336 'Fix the calculation so it matches the chart' (band to band as drawn). R140 a band counts as passed only once price is through it: gold 33c, BTC $2 (R338 'make it $2 on the break'). Scale rows = [channel width up to $, share %]; null = and above.
_tapReach_why: How close to a band counts as a tap. Love to fill.
_minSecondsLeft_why: Latest moment in a window she may enter. Love to fill.
_maxPriceAgeSec_why: A price older than this = no trade. Love to fill.
_exit_why: Exit plan. All null = hold to the bell. Love to fill.
